notes: v7 re-trim: trimmed p1 = report p6 Statement of Activities, p2 = report p7 Balance Sheet - Governmental Funds, p3 = report p26 Budgetary Comparison Schedule - All Fund Types (formerly the only page, p1), p4 = report p28 Combining Schedule of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances - Other Governmental Funds. Basis GAAP (accrual government-wide, modified accrual funds). The governmental funds revenues/expenditures statement is not trimmed, so governmental receipts and disbursements are the Statement of Activities governmental lines (p1): program charges for services by function plus general receipts (property taxes, state revenue, city taxes and fees, miscellaneous, interest); expenses by function. 'City taxes and fees' 713,709 has no breakdown in the trim (kept as taxes (unlabeled)). Interfund transfers, net (644,278) to business-type are transfers_out / business_type.transfers_net. Governmental net position roll-forward ties: 9,238,709 + 3,324,237 - 2,370,630 - 644,278 = 9,548,038 (p1), but that is net position, not fund balance; beginning fund balance is not shown, so beginning_fund_balance is null and reconcile cannot run. Ending fund balance 3,610,817 and ending cash (cash 3,560,289 + county treasurer 16,937) come from the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p2), used as balance_sheet because the government-wide Statement of Net Position is not trimmed. Business-type (water, electric, sewer) from the Statement of Activities: charges 2,025,069 + interest 47,942 - expenses 1,696,126 + transfers 644,278; net position 5,662,585 -> 6,683,748 ties. No proprietary cash flow statement: proprietary null. Detail: the Budgetary Comparison Schedule - All Fund Types (p3) charges to appropriations (Actual Amounts, budgetary basis) by function for governmental and business-type activities, as before; the earlier top-level disbursements from that page were replaced by the Statement of Activities lines. Budget column printed is Original Budget only, so budget_final is null. Receipts and transfers (resource inflows) 9,534,274 and budgetary fund balance beginning 6,417,103 / ending 4,875,153 on p3 are all funds combined (no governmental/business split) and are not recorded. Reconciliation on p3: cash 4,854,276 + county treasurer 16,937 + restricted 3,940 = 4,875,153. Other governmental funds combining schedule (p4): revenue lines (Keno, Reading Center) and transfers recorded per fund in detail; its expenditure lines (Law Enforcement public safety 145,729; Keno 8,018 and Reading Center 803 culture and recreation) are not recorded because they are already inside the p3 all-fund function lines (Police 145,729, Culture and recreation 224,322). Debt Services fund had no activity. Governmental funds balance sheet Nonspendable total printed 63,314 vs 64,314 from its fund columns (report_discrepancies). Read pages 1-4 of 4
